entities.name: Integrity Protection
entities.description: Mandatory protection mechanism for 5GMM NAS messages once valid security context exists. Responsible for ensuring message authenticity and integrity.

entities.name: Null Integrity Protection Algorithm 5G-IA0
entities.description: Null integrity protection algorithm that can be used in specific scenarios including unauthenticated UE emergency services, W-AGF acting for FN-RG, and W-AGF acting for N5GC device.

entities.name: Security Header Type
entities.description: Header field in NAS messages that indicates security protection status. Same rules apply regardless of integrity algorithm selection.

entities.name: NAS Sequence Number
entities.description: Sequence number used in integrity protection calculation along with NAS message content.

entities.name: Message Authentication Code
entities.description: MAC calculated for integrity protection of NAS messages using sequence number and message content.

entities.name: 5GMM Message
entities.description: NAS mobility management messages that require integrity protection once security context is established.

entities.name: 5GSM Message
entities.description: NAS session management messages that can be piggybacked in 5GMM messages.

entities.name: Unauthenticated UE Emergency Services
entities.description: Condition where UE is unauthenticated but emergency services establishment is allowed, permitting use of null integrity protection.

relations.description: 5GMM NAS messages require integrity protection once valid security context exists
Unauthenticated UE emergency services condition allows use of null integrity protection algorithm
NAS messages contain security header type field indicating protection status
Integrity protection calculation includes NAS sequence number along with message content
Integrity protection generates message authentication code for verification
5GMM messages can piggyback 5GSM messages with shared sequence number and MAC
